_about: Ethanol (1) + cyclohexane (2): excess molar enthalpy at 323.15 K and 101 kPa from Lien et al. (2003). Rows as in the ThermoML Archive record: mole fraction of ethanol, excess molar enthalpy in kJ/mol (as printed). The record gives the phase as one liquid over the whole range (x of ethanol 0.032-0.951).

source.citation: P.-J. Lien, H.-M. Lin, M.-J. Lee, Excess Molar Enthalpies for Binary Mixtures of Ethanol + Acetone, + Octane, + Cyclohexane and 1-Propanol + Acetone, + Octane, + Heptane at 323.15 (title as stored in the ThermoML record), J. Chem. Eng. Data 48 (2003) 359-361
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 9: ethanol + cyclohexane, excess molar enthalpy, variable mole fraction of ethanol, constraints T = 323.15 K and P = 101 kPa. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: Expanded uncertainties in the record: 0.005 to 0.02 kJ/mol. Values as stored in the ThermoML record (XML file), extracted with validation/python/thermoml_read.py; nothing converted or rounded. To be checked by a person against the record before use (AGENTS.md rule 4).
